prs.title: Editorial: Replace Number-specific term "finite" with "finite Number"
prs.author: gibson042
prs.body:
...fixing inappropriate auto-linking for uses of "finite" as a colloquial term

Fixes #3840

This does not affect [Web IDL](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/), [HTML](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/), or [WebAssembly](https://webassembly.github.io/spec/). [ECMA-402](https://tc39.es/ecma402/) has a corresponding PR at https://github.com/tc39/ecma402/pull/1091 , which can land independently of this one.
